## Formatting and parsing

SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y/%m/%d', DATE '2024-01-02')
=> "2024/01/02"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', PARSE_DATETIME('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S',
  '2024-01-02 03:04:05'))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S',
  '2024-01-02 03:04:05'))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Q|%e|%C|%F', DATE '2024-05-07')
=> "2| 7|20|2024-05-07"

SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%F %H', DATETIME '2024-01-02 03:04:05')
=> "2024-01-02 03"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%E3S|%E*S|%Z', DATETIME '2024-05-17 10:20:30.1234')
=> "30.123|30.1234|%Z"

SELECT FORMAT_TIME('%Y %H:%M:%E6S', TIME '01:02:03.000004')
=> "%Y 01:02:03.000004"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T %Ez', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00', 'Asia/Tokyo')
=> "2024-01-02 12:04:05 +09:00"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%H:%M', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00', '+05:30')
=> "08:34"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00', NULL)
=> null

SELECT FORMAT_DATE(NULL, DATE '2024-01-02')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00', 'Nowhere/Zone')
=> null

SELECT PARSE_DATE('%A %b %e %Y', 'Thursday Dec 25 2008')
=> "2008-12-25"

SELECT SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '2024-02-30')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', '2024-01-02x')
=> null

SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y', '2024')
=> "2024-01-01"

SELECT FORMAT_DATETIME('%F %H:%M:%E6S', PARSE_DATETIME('%F %H:%M:%E*S',
  '2024-01-02 03:04:05.123456789'))
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05.123456"

SELECT PARSE_TIME('%I:%M %p', '01:02 PM')
=> "13:02:00"

SELECT SAFE.PARSE_TIME('%H:%M', '25:00')
=> null

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T', PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%F %T', '2024-01-02 03:04:05', 'Asia/Tokyo'))
=> "2024-01-01 18:04:05"

SELECT FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%F %T', PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%F %T%Ez', '2024-01-02 03:04:05+09:00',
  'America/New_York'))
=> "2024-01-01 18:04:05"

SELECT PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%F', NULL)
=> null

SELECT FORMAT('%5.2f|%-5s|%05d|%x', 3.14159, 'ab', 42, 255)
=> " 3.14|ab   |00042|ff"

SELECT FORMAT("%'d|%e|%g", 1234567, 1.5, 1.5)
=> "1,234,567|1.500000e+00|1.5"

SELECT FORMAT('%T|%T|%t|%T', 'abc', b'ab', DATE '2024-01-02', DATE '2024-01-02')
=> "\"abc\"|b\"ab\"|2024-01-02|DATE \"2024-01-02\""

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', DATETIME '2024-01-02 03:04:05.5', TIMESTAMP '2024-01-02 03:04:05+00')
=> "2024-01-02 03:04:05.500|TIMESTAMP \"2024-01-02 03:04:05+00\""

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T|%T|%t', CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64), CAST('-inf' AS FLOAT64), 1.0, true)
=> "nan|CAST(\"-inf\" AS FLOAT64)|1.0|true"

SELECT FORMAT('%t|%T', NULL, NULL)
=> "NULL|NULL"

SELECT FORMAT('%d', NULL)
=> null

SELECT FORMAT(CAST(NULL AS STRING), 1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.FORMAT(CONCAT('%', 'd'), 'a')
=> null

# NUMERIC and BIGNUMERIC are written without trailing fractional zeros, in results and as STRING.
SELECT NUMERIC '1.210'
=> "1.21"

SELECT BIGNUMERIC '-2.50'
=> "-2.5"

SELECT NUMERIC '100'
=> "100"

SELECT SUM(x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '1.5', NUMERIC '2.5']) x
=> "4"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '3.10']) x
=> "3.1"

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([BIGNUMERIC '0.000']) x
=> "0"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(CAST(ARRAY_AGG(x ORDER BY x) AS ARRAY<STRING>), ',')
FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '1.50', NUMERIC '20']) x
=> error:

## Casts from STRING accept only BigQuery's canonical formats

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS DATE) FROM UNNEST(['2009-02-13 ']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS DATE) FROM UNNEST(['998-02-13']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS DATE) FROM UNNEST(['2009/02/13']) AS x
=> null

SELECT CAST(x AS DATE) FROM UNNEST(['2009-2-3']) AS x
=> "2009-02-03"

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS TIME) FROM UNNEST(['12:34:56.123456+08:00']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS DATETIME) FROM UNNEST([' 2006-01-02 12:34:56.123456 ']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS TIMESTAMP) FROM UNNEST(['10000-01-01 00:00:00']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS DATE) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS STRING)]) AS x
=> null

## Casts to STRING format as BigQuery does

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(0 AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "0"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(123 AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "123"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.12345']) AS x
=> "01:02:03.123450"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> null

## Array casts require identical element types; structs cast fields by position

# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/conversion_functions#cast_as_array

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(CAST(x AS ARRAY<INT64>)) FROM (SELECT [1, 2] AS x)
=> "2"

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS ARRAY<INT64>) IS NULL FROM (SELECT CAST(NULL AS ARRAY<INT64>) AS x)
=> "true"

# A struct is cast field by field in order, taking the field names of the target type.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(CAST(s AS STRUCT<b INT64, c STRING>)) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('1' AS a, 2 AS b)]) s
=> "{\"b\":1,\"c\":\"2\"}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(CAST(x AS ARRAY<STRUCT<s STRING>>))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([STRUCT(NUMERIC '1.50' AS n)] AS x)])
=> error:

# SAFE_CAST still rejects incompatible array types during analysis. For supported struct casts,
# a failing field makes the whole struct NULL; a NULL field does not fail.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(SAFE_CAST(x AS ARRAY<INT64>)) FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(['1', NULL] AS x)])
=> error:

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS ARRAY<INT64>) IS NULL FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(['1', 'x'] AS x)])
=> error:

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS ARRAY<DATE>) IS NULL FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(['2024-01-01', '2024/01/01'] AS x)])
=> error:

SELECT SAFE_CAST(s AS STRUCT<a INT64, b STRING>) IS NULL FROM UNNEST([STRUCT('x' AS a, 1 AS b)]) s
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS ARRAY<STRUCT<a INT64>>) IS NULL
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT([STRUCT('1' AS a), STRUCT('x' AS a)] AS x)])
=> error:

# Answers collected from BigQuery with bqanswers.
SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST('-0' AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "-0"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(1e20 AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "1e+20"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([CAST(0.1 AS FLOAT64)]) AS x
=> "0.1"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIME '01:02:03.12']) AS x
=> "01:02:03.120"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([DATETIME '2006-01-02 12:34:56.12345']) AS x
=> "2006-01-02 12:34:56.123450"

SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST([TIMESTAMP '2006-01-02 12:34:56.12345+00']) AS x
=> "2006-01-02 12:34:56.123450+00"

SELECT CAST(CAST(x AS TIMESTAMP) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['2014-01-31 12:12:34 America/Los_Angeles']) AS x
=> "2014-01-31 20:12:34+00"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(CAST(x AS ARRAY<STRING>), ',') FROM (SELECT [CAST(1.5 AS FLOAT64), 2] AS x)
=> error: Casting between arrays with incompatible element types is not supported: Invalid cast from ARRAY<FLOAT64> to ARRAY<STRING> at [1:29]

SELECT SAFE.TIMESTAMP(x, 'UTC') IS NULL FROM UNNEST(['2008-12-25 15:30:00+00']) AS x
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.TIMESTAMP(x) IS NULL FROM UNNEST(['2008/12/25 15:30:00']) AS x
=> "true"
